rules.activation: All presets off: opt-in because data cannot meet exact-game identities/numbers, even if bounded native loading passes. Protected wiring in WIRING.md.
rules.appearance: Keep every appearance, height/weight, age, commentary/photo, contract and unknown bit. Name, jersey and exact main-table college index only may change.
rules.college: Source college must match exactly one main table string; encode its zero-based index, never a field-relative pointer. Otherwise retain retail word.
rules.editorial_qbs: HYPOTHESIS: season-regular preferences Daryle Lamonica (1968 OAK), Dan Fouts (1981 SD), Dave Krieg (1992 KC) correct tenure's preference for long-serving backups. These editorial historical judgments have supplied name/season/role membership validation only; no supplied game-start evidence or external verification. All other depth choices use the stated heuristic.
rules.fillers: Maximize compatible selected-season identities first. Fill scarce role slots with nearest-season same-franchise identities, explicitly labeled; no duplicate or invented names. These fillers are not members of the claimed game roster.
rules.names: Use supplied full_name split by supplied last_name; preserve familiar names from full_name when first_name is legal name. Existing codec allocator only; no truncation.
rules.numbers: Use selected source row number when 1..99. Else nearest season of the same player and franchise if available, explicitly marked uncertain. Else retain retail slot number and mark unknown. Source zero is missing, not a real jersey.
rules.positions: Keep each retail slot code, rank, side and team pointer. Broader DB/LB/OL/RB/DL roles may fill compatible slots; all concessions listed per player.
rules.ratings: Keep all 28 retail rating/style bytes exactly. No Hall of Fame, All-Pro or Pro Bowl signal supplied; no adjustment. Native C1030 clamps ratings to 0..100.
rules.shared_seasons: Prefer a used moment matching file season; then calendar date year; then nearest season, lower moment index breaks ties. Unique files take their moment season. January/February belong to preceding season.
rules.starters: No game starts or depth ordinal supplied. Retain source-matched real retail identities in compatible slots of the chosen season. Otherwise use status/position, team tenure in the current and preceding three seasons, available experience/draft and named narrative participants as weak deterministic ranking inputs, not established starters.
